name: Hauiti Hākopa
story: Hauiti Hākopa’s research uses GIS to work with ancestral landscapes, cultural sites, oral narratives and whakapapa.

Hauiti Hākopa’s research connects GIS with ancestral landscapes, cultural sites, oral narratives and whakapapa. Ngā Pae o te Māramatanga’s account describes the use of mapping technology to support collecting and working with that information. This places the technology within a research practice shaped by the knowledge and relationships associated with the places.
